_comment: Enhancer genre presets. These are DIRECTING axes (camera restraint, pacing, beat shape, lighting change, blocking, guardrails) — not visual style. Visual style stays in styles.json. Add your own entries freely.

_schema.label: dropdown label
_schema.camera: camera distance / movement discipline for this genre
_schema.pacing: beat count and rhythm across the clip
_schema.beats: the default dramatic shape to fill in
_schema.lighting: how light should change over time
_schema.blocking: where subjects are placed and how they move through frame
_schema.guards: negative guardrails — what this genre must NOT do

slice_of_life.label: 01. 일상 · 슬라이스 오브 라이프
slice_of_life.camera: eye-level, mostly locked off or a very small drift; medium and medium-wide framing; the camera observes rather than chases
slice_of_life.pacing: one unhurried beat, or two at most; long held moments; nothing is rushed
slice_of_life.beats: establish the space and the mood → one small human action (a hand, a glance, an object picked up) → a settling breath afterwards
slice_of_life.lighting: one dominant natural source with a clear direction; slow, gentle change such as a cloud passing or light shifting across a surface
slice_of_life.blocking: the subject stays roughly where they are; small gestures rather than travel across the frame
slice_of_life.sound: detailed room tone, small specific foley (cloth, cup, footstep), distant ambience
slice_of_life.guards: no dramatic camera moves, no fast cuts, no sudden events, no action-movie energy

action.label: 02. 액션
action.camera: tracking and handheld energy, low angles, sudden distance changes; large amplitude at fast speed is welcome
action.pacing: two to four tight beats; every beat escalates; no dead air
action.beats: a coiled preparation → the explosive move → the impact and its consequence → the aftermath pose or recovery
action.lighting: hard contrast, strong rim separation, sparks or flashes tied to impacts
action.blocking: subjects cross the frame decisively, enter and exit frame edges, change screen direction on impacts; when two subjects engage, give each one its own stance and its own line — attacker and defender never share a sentence
action.sound: impacts with weight, cloth and air movement, breath between exertions
action.guards: no floaty slow drifting, no ambiguous geography, never let two consecutive beats have the same energy level

pov_first_person.label: 03. POV · 1인칭
pov_first_person.camera: fixed at the subject's actual eye height, facing forward; only micro-movement and small sway; the camera IS the character's head
pov_first_person.pacing: one continuous take; changes come from the world moving, not from cutting
pov_first_person.beats: establish what the viewer's own eyes see → something changes in the world in front of them → their own hands react or the view resolves
pov_first_person.lighting: light changes must be motivated by the environment the viewer is passing through, and must spill onto the visible hands and nearby surfaces
pov_first_person.blocking: only the viewer's own hands, arms and sleeves ever appear, entering from the lower edge of frame; everything else is the outside world
pov_first_person.sound: close, head-adjacent sound — own breathing, own clothing, handled objects loud; the world slightly behind that
pov_first_person.guards: the camera NEVER orbits, never rotates around the subject, never cuts to a third-person view, never shows the viewer's face or full body; no large zooms, no perspective swings

travel_transition.label: 04. 이동 · 여정 (트랜지션 중심)
travel_transition.camera: locked to the moving vehicle or body; the frame is stable while the world streams past it
travel_transition.pacing: three beats built around one clear threshold — before, crossing, after
travel_transition.beats: the departure world streaming past → the threshold that hides it (tunnel, doorway, crest, fog) → the arrival world revealed as different
travel_transition.lighting: the threshold IS the lighting event — bright to dark to bright, or cool to warm; interior surfaces must pick up each change
travel_transition.blocking: the subject barely moves; the background does all the travelling, horizontally and steadily
travel_transition.sound: continuous transport rhythm that changes character at the threshold (open air → enclosed reverb → open air)
travel_transition.guards: the interior or the subject must not drift or wobble independently; do not cut across the threshold — the change happens inside one continuous view

emotion_romance.label: 05. 감정 · 로맨스
emotion_romance.camera: slow push in with small amplitude, or a patient static shot; close and medium-close framing; shallow separation from the background
emotion_romance.pacing: one long beat that breathes; the change is internal and small
emotion_romance.beats: a held stillness → the smallest physical tell (a breath, a blink, fingers tightening, eyes moving) → the moment landing and holding
emotion_romance.lighting: soft, warm, wrapping; a gentle bloom on the edge of the face and hair; slow rise or slow fade
emotion_romance.blocking: minimal travel; proximity and small shifts in distance carry everything
emotion_romance.sound: near silence with one or two intimate details — breath, fabric, a distant room
emotion_romance.guards: no fast movement, no cuts on the emotional beat, no busy background action, never describe the feeling itself — only the visible tell

horror_suspense.label: 06. 호러 · 서스펜스
horror_suspense.camera: static and patient, or a very slow creep; deliberately withhold — keep things at the edge of frame or just out of focus
horror_suspense.pacing: a long quiet stretch, then one change; the quiet must be genuinely long
horror_suspense.beats: an ordinary space held slightly too long → a small wrongness appears at the periphery → the reveal or the refusal to reveal
horror_suspense.lighting: deep shadow with one weak source; darkness that hides most of the frame; light that flickers or fails
horror_suspense.blocking: movement happens in the background or the frame edge, not the centre; the subject often has their back to it
horror_suspense.sound: near-silence with a low floor; one specific sound out of place; the absence of expected sound
horror_suspense.guards: no jump-scare camera lurches, no fast zooms, do not show the threat fully unless asked, never fill the quiet with music

commercial_product.label: 07. 광고 · 제품
commercial_product.camera: precise mechanical moves — slow arcs, exact push-ins, locked hero holds; macro detail framing
commercial_product.pacing: three crisp beats landing on a final hold; every move has an exact end position
commercial_product.beats: a detail or texture → the action that demonstrates the product → the hero composition holding still
commercial_product.lighting: large soft sources with controlled edge highlights; clean whites; the light itself is styled
commercial_product.blocking: the product is always the compositional anchor; hands serve it and leave frame
commercial_product.sound: hyper-detailed close foley — one click, one pour, one release — over near silence
commercial_product.guards: no handheld shake, no clutter, no dust or wear, no ambiguous framing, nothing upstages the product

music_video.label: 08. 뮤직비디오 · 리듬
music_video.camera: expressive and mobile — arcs, rolls, whip movement, sudden distance jumps; movement is choreography
music_video.pacing: cuts and moves land on a beat; three to four punchy segments
music_video.beats: a striking opening image → a movement that answers the rhythm → an escalation → a final held pose
music_video.lighting: saturated and directional, pulsing or strobing, colour separation between foreground and background
music_video.blocking: the subject drives the frame — entering, filling, exiting on rhythm
music_video.sound: diegetic accents that lock to the rhythm; the space itself feels percussive
music_video.guards: no documentary neutrality, no flat daylight, no aimless drifting between beats

adult_intimate.label: 09. 성인 · 친밀 장면
adult_intimate.camera: commit to ONE camera relationship and hold it — a fixed POV eye-line, or a locked close framing; movement limited to micro-drift and the motion already present in the scene
adult_intimate.pacing: one continuous unbroken beat; the change is in intensity, not in location; cutting breaks the continuity this genre depends on
adult_intimate.beats: each participant's posture and the contact between them established → one participant drives a movement while the other responds → a gradual build in range and tempo → a sustained peak → a settling
adult_intimate.lighting: one soft dominant source, warm; skin and fabric keep a consistent tone across the whole clip; no lighting change unless asked
adult_intimate.blocking: fix each participant separately before any movement is described — which way each one faces, whether their body axis is upright, horizontal or inclined, what supports them, where their limbs rest — then state the spatial relation between them (who is above, behind, beside or in front, and what is in contact with what); never describe two participants in one shared sentence, and state explicitly what stays inside the frame and what stays outside it
adult_intimate.sound: close breathing, fabric and contact detail, room tone; typically no score
adult_intimate.guards: never cut, never change camera distance mid-clip, never orbit or switch to a third-person view, never introduce a new character or location, never change the lighting; keep the visible framing boundaries stated so the model does not drift outside them

free.label: 10. 자유 (프리셋 없이 브리프만 확장)
free.camera: follow whatever the brief implies; do not impose a genre grammar
free.beats: expand only what the brief already contains — fill in timing, framing and light, invent nothing new
free.guards: do not add events, characters, locations or emotions that the brief did not ask for
